mapper.insert: insert into notify_task( activity_id, team_id, notify_category, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json, uuid, last_error, create_time, update_time) values( #{activityId}, #{teamId}, #{notifyCategory}, #{notifyType}, #{notifyMQ}, #{notifyUrl}, #{notifyCount}, #{notifyStatus}, #{parameterJson}, #{uuid}, #{lastError}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select activity_id, team_id, notify_category, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json, uuid, last_error from notify_task where notify_status in (0, 2) or (notify_status = 4 and update_time <= date_sub(now(), interval 10 minute)) order by id asc limit 50

select activity_id, team_id, notify_category, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json, uuid, last_error from notify_task where team_id = #{teamId} and (notify_status in (0, 2) or (notify_status = 4 and update_time <= date_sub(now(), interval 10 minute))) order by id asc
mapper.update: update notify_task set notify_count = notify_count + 1, notify_status = 1, last_error = null, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and uuid = #{uuid} and notify_status = 4
update notify_task set notify_count = notify_count + 1, notify_status = 3, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and uuid = #{uuid} and notify_status = 4
update notify_task set notify_count = notify_count + 1, notify_status = 2, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and uuid = #{uuid} and notify_status = 4
